q: The ____ in a measurement consist of all the certain digits in that measurement plus one uncertain or estimated digit.
e: The significant figures in a measurement consist of all the certain digits in that measurement plus one uncertain or estimated digit. Significant figures report the digits that are reliably measured in a value.

q: All ____ digits in a measurement are significant.
e: All nonzero digits in a measurement are significant. Significant figures start at the first nonzero digit. leading zeros only place the decimal. Significant figures report the digits that are reliably measured in a value.

q: Zeros that appear between other nonzero digits are always ____.
e: Zeros that appear between other nonzero digits are always significant. Significant figures start at the first nonzero digit. leading zeros only place the decimal. Significant figures report the digits that are reliably measured in a value.

q: Zeros that appear in front of all of the nonzero digits are called ____.
e: Zeros that appear in front of all of the nonzero digits are called left end zeros. Every nonzero digit in a measured value is significant. Leading zeros only place the decimal point and are not significant figures.

q: Left end zeros are ____ significant.
e: Left end zeros are never significant. Significant figures start at the first nonzero digit. leading zeros only place the decimal. Significant figures report the digits that are reliably measured in a value.

q: Zeros that appear after all nonzero digits are ____.
e: Zeros that appear after all nonzero digits are right end zeros. Trailing zeros are significant only when a decimal point shows they were measured. Every nonzero digit in a measured value is significant.

q: Right end zeros in a number that lacks a decimal point are ____ significant.

q: Right end zeros in a number with a decimal point are ____.
